name: Ootsuki Shinobu
source:
A frivolous warrior who frequently comes to Yoshiwara. Carefree and is hard to grasp. In "Oukaya", he can always be seen drunk and laying his hands on different harlots.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/11/19/yoshiwara-higanbana/]Otome Jikan's character profile translations[/URL].]
